text: {"lessons":["Selling A, B, E, and D at gains felt rewarding, but I should not sell simply to lock in a small profit; I should consider each stock’s outlook and my overall plan.","I made no trades through the later declines and recovery. I should avoid reacting to short-term moves, while still reviewing my holdings periodically.","I judge positions against my purchase price and feel losses more sharply than gains. I should focus on the portfolio’s value and risk rather than let my cost basis or loss aversion drive decisions."]}
